issues.note: AFI lists several durations; no runtime is published until a specific release version is established.
Original-production producer is Gary Kurtz. Prior combined legacy value remains in the immutable snapshot and change log; later-edition credits are outside this field.
US theatrical release is 21 May 1980. The former 17 May value is preserved in the change log; Wikidata qualifies it as a Washington, DC event, not the same release event.
Screenplay credits and story credit are separate; second-unit directors are not presented as co-directors.
Selected episode blocks are cited; complete season 1 credits and episode records remain outside this pilot.
Full episode credits and broadcast-versus-chronological ordering remain for the episode review stage.
